BEFORE YOUR CLEAN

Let’s clear
a few things up.

Do you bring cleaning products and equipment?
We’ll agree what’s needed when you enquire. If you have preferred products, delicate surfaces or allergies, tell us so we can plan appropriately.
Can I book a regular cleaner?
Yes, ask us about regular cleaning. Share your preferred days and frequency, and we’ll discuss current availability.
What should I do before the visit?
Let us know about access and any areas needing extra care. Clearing everyday clutter from floors and surfaces helps us spend more of the agreed time cleaning.
Does a move-out clean guarantee my deposit back?
We’ll agree a cleaning checklist with you, but deposit decisions are made by your landlord or agent. Share any inventory or required cleaning list before we quote.
